patterns.fee: (?<=International(?: students)?\s+(?:(?!Domestic)[^\d$]){0,40}(?:20\d\d [a-z ]{5,30}:\s*\$[\d,]+\s*(?:\(\d+ points\)|per \d+ points)\s*)?)2026 (?:tuition fee estimate|Special Programme Fee|annual fee estimate):\s*\$\s?([\d,]+)\s*(?:\(120 points\)|per 120 points)

config.notes: UC qualification pages (www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/academic-study/qualifications/...). No programme or CRICOS code is printed, so patterns use labels only. Two layouts: (a) "Degree Structure - Start ... / POINTS / Degree Structure - Duration ..."; (b) banner "International students START 13 July 2027 POINTS 180 DURATION 1 year full time". Fee: the 2026 line of the International (students) fee box ("tuition fee estimate", "Special Programme Fee" or "annual fee estimate"), directly after the International label or after one earlier-year line, and only when it is a 120-point (one full-time year) figure. THE YEAR 2026 IS FIXED IN THE FEE PATTERN AND MUST BE MOVED ON EACH YEAR. 60-, 150- and 180-point figures are whole-qualification amounts and ranges are ambiguous, so they are skipped on purpose. Domestic and SSL boxes are never read. Study level: breadcrumb after Qualifications (e.g. Bachelor's degree). IELTS is not on these pages (they link to central undergraduate/postgraduate language requirement pages). Campus and delivery mode are not printed. Some education/teaching pages carry no start line.
